instruction: Tidy up my desk: pens stand upright in the magenta pen holder, the mug goes on the blue coaster, notebooks go on the orange tray, and crumpled paper balls go into the red wastebasket. Some things are already where they belong; leave them there.

obs = observe()
candidates = grasp_candidates("blue_block")

# The block is inside red_bin (rim_height=0.12).
# Hand is 0.21m long along finger direction, 0.065m across.
# In red_bin (at [-0.01, 0.2433]), blue_block is at [-0.029, 0.203], near the bottom/rim.
# Look for candidate that minimizes obstacle collision or has hand_clear/fingers_clear.
# Let's inspect all candidates:
valid_candidates = [c for c in candidates if c.get("fits_open_fingers", True)]

# If none have hand_clear == True, we should pick the one with highest height / least hand collision
# Notice id 3 had yaw = -1.554 (along y-axis), where bin center is at y=0.2433, causing hand (0.21m long) to hit bin wall!
# Grasping across short side (yaw ≈ 0.016, along x-axis) directs the hand along x instead of into the bin center/rim.
# Furthermore, adjust height higher (e.g. near top of block, height=0.045) to avoid colliding with bin rim/floor.
best = None
for c in valid_candidates:
    # Prefer yaw close to 0 or pi (fingers along x) so the 0.21m hand doesn't hit the bin wall in y
    if abs(math.cos(c["yaw"])) > 0.7:
        if best is None or c.get("height", 0) > best.get("height", 0):
            best = dict(c)

if best is None:
    best = dict(valid_candidates[0])

# Ensure height is at a safe graspable level near the top of the block
best["height"] = max(best["height"], obs["objects"]["blue_block"]["height"] - 0.01)

res = grasp(best)
if not res.get("holding_something", False):
    # Retry with slight height adjustment if needed
    best["height"] = 0.035
    grasp(best)

tray = obs["zones"]["orange_tray"]
carry_to(tray["center"][0], tray["center"][1], height=0.25)
lower_until_contact()
open_gripper()
retreat(dz=0.15)
